verse: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, who are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come forth for Me One to be ruler over Israel, One whose origins are of old, from the days of eternity.
story: Of all the towns God could have chosen, He names the one most people had never noticed.

Bethlehem was small among the clans of Judah, a village rather than a capital. Yet from it, God says, will come a ruler over Israel, and His origins reach back to ancient days, to eternity. Micah then pictures this ruler as a shepherd who feeds His flock in the strength of the LORD. The promise is for people who feel overlooked: God builds His greatest work from places the world dismisses.
If you feel small this week, notice where God likes to begin. Bethlehem was enough.
theme: Advent: waiting, promise, the coming King
